sourceRulesScreened.rule: An improvised weapon includes any object the user can wield in one or two hands; an object with no resemblance to a weapon deals 1d4 damage of a Director-assigned appropriate type.

It does not itself establish Minor Conjuration access at the witness state, object shape/custody, attack roll, or resolution.
